issues.detail: The Greek verb 'εκπεσειν' (ekpesein) is a passive construction in the sense of 'to be cast out' or 'to be thrown out'. The Vietnamese translation 'bị tấp lên' (be washed up/washed ashore) changes the mechanism of the action from being 'cast out' (active/intentional by an agent) to 'washed up' (passive by nature/waves).
